subject.title: [Feature]: Offline Command Queue for iOS/Android Node App

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for a staged durable mobile command outbox, with the open Android text-outbox PR treated as the first slice rather than the full fix?
rationale: Current main has only scoped queues and the open implementation covers only Android text, while the full request changes mobile persistence, privacy, replay, and background-sync behavior.

options.title: Stage the mobile outbox
options.body: Review the Android text outbox as the first slice, then require explicit shared payload, privacy, iOS, and voice follow-ups before closing this issue.

options.title: Require design first
options.body: Pause implementation PRs until maintainers approve a cross-platform mobile outbox contract and security model.

options.title: Narrow or defer
options.body: Defer the broader offline command queue until read-only offline cache work lands and re-scope this issue to the smallest remaining mobile send gap.

recommendation.title: Stage the mobile outbox
recommendation.body: Review the Android text outbox as the first slice, then require explicit shared payload, privacy, iOS, and voice follow-ups before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the current iOS Watch queue prior art and the open Android text-outbox candidate, making them the best available routing owner for the staged scope decision.
